<thought>We need a single retrosynthetic step that disconnects the target into two simpler precursors via a cycloaddition. The forward reaction loses a ketone and a C‑C triple bond, forming a new C‑C bond and breaking a C‑O bond (the ester carbonyl). Therefore, in the retrosynthetic direction we should break the C‑C bond that joins the two unsaturated fragments and re‑form a ketone and an alkyne. I will search the template catalog for reactions that break a ketone and a C‑C triple bond while forming a C‑C bond.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>

  "functional_groups_formed": null,
